project_name: CNNA (ComplemeNt Net Architecture) — From Primitive Provenance to Mathematical Structure
paper_title: From Primitive Provenance to Mathematical Structure: A Response-Coupled Derivation on a Growing b-ary Tree
main_title: From Primitive Provenance to Mathematical Structure
subtitle: A Response-Coupled Derivation on a Growing b-ary Tree
current_formal_specialization: Deterministic finite response-coupled provenance growth on a bounded b-ary address grammar
namespace_stability: The Lean and Python namespaces remain CNNA; this is a scientific-title and conceptual-scope update, not an API rename.
status_guard: The universal open-provenance statement is a research hypothesis. Only nodewise claims carrying their existing evidence status are asserted as proved.
architectural_identity: CNNA is the throughgoing architecture in which one historically grown provenance net is repeatedly resolved into a realized or retained part, a cut- or stage-relative complement, and an interface through which effective response and the next birth are determined.
origin_of_architecture: The architecture begins with the transition from the empty carrier to the first realized node, becomes structurally explicit when the b-ary grammar distinguishes the born prefix from open continuation slots, and becomes a nontrivial response-capable net with the first non-root birth and its directed relation.
complement_guard: Complement is relational and cut-, scale-, or projection-relative; it is not an intrinsic permanent partner assigned to each node.
